# Goleu AI

> Goleu AI is a free tool that recommends the best SaaS stack for your team based on team roles, budget, and current tools.

Goleu AI is completely free and requires no sign-up. You answer four short steps (team roles and headcount, the tools you already use, cloud & infrastructure, and AI services), which takes about 3 minutes on average, and get SaaS recommendations for collaboration, development, design, and AI.

## Main pages

- [Home](%SITE_URL%/): What Goleu AI does, how it works, and FAQ
- [Start the quiz](%SITE_URL%/quiz): Step 1 of the recommendation flow
- [Privacy Policy](%SITE_URL%/privacy): What data is collected and how long it is kept (Korean)
- [Terms of Service](%SITE_URL%/terms): Terms of use (Korean)
